migration.phase_1: Add one service descriptor plus one isolated service config. Do not copy shared source corpora.
migration.phase_2: Add only service-specific scopes and verification implementations required by the real service.
migration.phase_3: Make runtime loaders and routes service-aware while preserving legacy dayservice URLs.
migration.phase_4: Generalize only behavior that is duplicated by at least two real services.

non_goals: No database introduction solely for multi-service support.
No blanket refactor of existing dayservice pipelines.
No automatic promotion of machine verification into human verification or currentness.
